description: Send a WhatsApp verification code to the agent's mobile number. Publishing listings requires a verified WhatsApp number — if account_status shows can_publish=false, use this to start verification. A 6-digit code is delivered to the number over WhatsApp; then call verify_whatsapp_code with it.

phone.description: Mobile number in international format, e.g. +595981234567

name: send_whatsapp_verification
title: send_whatsapp_verification
